executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from urllib.parse import urljoin
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor,as_completed
import json,hashlib,re,requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
base=Path('reports/research/510300_industrial_complete_original_source_followthrough_v1')
def readj(p):return json.loads(Path(p).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def dump(n,x):
 p=base/n;assert not p.exists(),n+'已存在，禁止重发或覆盖'
 p.write_text(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
headers=readj(base/'全部36原查询实际来源标题及拒绝范围.json')
allheaders=[h for b in headers['batches'] for h in b['all_actual_source_headers']]
urls={
 '2018M12':'https://www.stats.gov.cn/xxgk/sjfb/zxfb2020/201901/t20190128_1768279.html',
 '2019M09':'https://www.stats.gov.cn/xxgk/sjfb/zxfb2020/201910/t20191027_1768134.html',
 '2020M10':'https://www.stats.gov.cn/xxgk/sjfb/zxfb2020/202011/t20201127_1805671.html'}
fixed=[]
for period,url in urls.items():
 h=next(h for h in allheaders if h['url']==url)
 excerpt=h['original_result_excerpt']
 assert (period=='2018M12' and '2018年规模以上工业企业' in excerpt and '全年累计' in excerpt) or (period=='2019M09' and '2019年1—9月份规模以上工业企业' in excerpt) or (period=='2020M10' and '2020年1—10月份全国规模以上工业企业' in excerpt)
 fixed.append({**h,'economic_period':period,'corrected_identity_method':'同一实际查询原表累计期及同条原标题；不是按URL年月猜测'})
e88=Path('reports/research/510300_industrial_multidimensional_cash_constraint_source_v1/原首批5当前原全文与取得回执.json')
cached={x['url']:x for x in readj(e88)['targets']}
reuse=[]
for x in fixed[:2]:
 c=cached[x['url']];assert sha(c['html_path'])==c['sha256']
 reuse.append({**x,'status':'CACHED_REUSE_NO_GET','path':c['html_path'],'full_text_path':c['text_path'],'sha256':c['sha256'],'status_code':c['status_code']})
alt='https://www.stats.gov.cn/xxgk/sjfb/zxfb2020/202004/t20200427_1767702.html'
oldquery=Path('reports/research/510300_industrial_full_government_original_carrier_probe_v1/原四官方查询实际回执.json')
assert alt in oldquery.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
prior=readj(base/'全部第一候选原报告实际取得回执.json')['reports']
assert not any(r['url'] in [urls['2020M10'],alt] for r in prior)
targets=[
 {**fixed[2],'raw_file_stem':'2020M10','source_role':'FIRST_REAL_LOCATOR_CORRECTED_SAME_QUERY_SOURCE'},
 {'economic_period':'2020M03','url':alt,'raw_file_stem':'2020M03_原信息公开对照','source_role':'SECOND_REAL_ORIGINAL_SCOPE_VARIANT','source_query_receipt':oldquery.as_posix(),'source_query_sha256':sha(oldquery),'reason':'先前真实查询摘要原应收标题与现代原载体有潜在范围差异，金融前读同原期第二不同载体，不靠摘录补量'}]
dump('同原查询定位修正及原口径对照请求前登记.json',{'at':now(),'initial_locator_path':(base/'固定36原期真实定位及最多两候选登记.json').as_posix(),'initial_locator_sha256':sha(base/'固定36原期真实定位及最多两候选登记.json'),'initial_identity_error':'通用信息公开搜索标题忽略同行嵌入的原文章标题和原表累计期；初次五期未定位事实保留。','same_actual_queries_reused':True,'new_queries':0,'cached_reuses':reuse,'different_real_first_GETs':targets,'budget_before':31,'budget_after_max':33,'original_max':72,'each_period_candidate_max':2,'new_stock_labels':0,'new_fits':0})
rs=[]
def fetch(t):
 out={**t,'started_at':now(),'attempt':1,'raw_GET_retries':0}
 try:
  r=requests.get(t['url'],timeout=(10,30));p=base/'sources'/(t['raw_file_stem']+'.html')
  assert not p.exists();p.write_bytes(r.content)
  s=BeautifulSoup(r.content.decode('utf-8-sig',errors='replace'),'html.parser');full=s.get_text('\n',strip=True)
  fp=base/'sources'/(t['raw_file_stem']+'_全文.txt');assert not fp.exists();fp.write_text(full,encoding='utf-8')
  leaves=[tb for tb in s.find_all('table') if not tb.find('table')]
  out.update(status_code=r.status_code,final_url=r.url,path=p.as_posix(),full_text_path=fp.as_posix(),sha256=hashlib.sha256(r.content).hexdigest(),bytes=len(r.content),status='BROWSER_CHECK_ONLY_NO_REPORT' if 'Please enable JavaScript and refresh the page.' in full else ('CURRENT_FULL_ORIGINAL_REPORT_CONTENT_CANDIDATE' if r.status_code==200 and leaves and '平均回收期' in full and '附注' in full else 'UNKNOWN_NOT_COMPLETE_ORIGINAL'),full_text=full)
  out['original_metadata']=[dict(m.attrs) for m in s.select('meta')];out['all_original_tables']=[]
  for ti,tb in enumerate(leaves):
   rows=[]
   for tr in tb.find_all('tr'):
    cs=[re.sub(r'\s+','',c.get_text(' ',strip=True)) for c in tr.find_all(['td','th'],recursive=False)]
    if cs:rows.append(cs)
   out['all_original_tables'].append({'leaf_index':ti,'rows':rows})
  out['all_original_links']=[{'text':a.get_text(' ',strip=True),'raw_href':a['href'],'absolute_url':urljoin(r.url,a['href'])} for a in s.select('a[href]')]
 except Exception as e:out.update(status='GET_FAILED_NO_RETRY',error_type=type(e).__name__,error=str(e))
 out['completed_at']=now();return out
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
 for f in as_completed([pool.submit(fetch,t) for t in targets]):
  r=f.result();rs.append(r);print('不同原载体首次取得',r['economic_period'],r['status'],flush=True)
dump('同查询修正及同原期不同口径载体实际取得回执.json',{'at':now(),'reports':rs,'cached_reuses':reuse,'actual_distinct_new_GETs':len(rs),'additional_queries':0,'raw_GET_retries':0,'all79_preserved':True,'new_stock_labels':0,'new_fits':0})
